reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code is the first time a supplement ad has answered my 'is it tested or just marketing' question. At $24.99 for the first box and a money-back guarantee with nothing to send back, I can afford to try one box.
objection: A report on their own page is still their word until I see the lab is a real one I can look up. I also have a drawer of half-used bottles, so I do not want to buy another one I quit after a week.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab turned out not to be a real, independent lab, or the report did not match the batch number on the box, I would not buy.
